findings.what: fd leak: os.open() before validation; any corrupt-file exception left the descriptor open. ~1500 corrupt opens -> EMFILE 'Too many open files' (fuzz target exited).
findings.fix: try/except BaseException around init body closes _mm/_fd before re-raise

findings.what: crafted header with page_recs=0 -> unguarded ZeroDivisionError in n_pages computation (crash-class on file data).
findings.fix: read_v2_meta rejects page_recs < 1 with StorageError (validation class)

negative_results: hypothesis+random-mutation campaigns on v1 found NOTHING beyond classifiable StorageError paths (guards from v0.7-era review held);

t3 found no defect but confirmed decode_unsigned is TOTAL on arbitrary 5-tuples: out-of-range residues never raise, they silently decode to some value in [0,M) — documented hazard for callers building on untrusted residues (graph/epistemic layer pre-validates).
PackedStore.from_bytes (spec target) does not exist on any Python side (verified: only Rust binding test_cross_language.py:199) — fuzzed the live equivalents instead; no fake target.
